descobrir.chamada: What is circulating across communities, lines other people built and the #topics you follow, with no scoreboard and nobody exposed.

estudar.chamada: Study tools that respect your pace. What is yours stays on this device; what belongs to the class only leaves as a total.

privacidade.semLista: No screen here shows a list of people, who followed, who answered or who proposed.
privacidade.semNumero: No count of people below 3 ever appears. Where possible we only show a range ("a few", "dozens").
privacidade.aparelho: Pace, decks, source shelf, micro-lessons and the end of the feed stay only on this device. Quick exit erases all of it.

erros.desligado: This part of Alumia is turned off right now.
erros.sem_permissao: You are not allowed to do this.
erros.consentimento: Accept Alumia's rules to use this part.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many requests in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
erros.nao_encontrado: We could not find this. It may have been removed.
erros.nao_encontrada: We could not find this line. Whoever published it may have removed it.
erros.invalido: Some field is not right. Check it and try again.
erros.outro: It did not work right now. Try again in a little while.
erros.bloqueado: This server is blocked in Alumia's Fediverse.
erros.sem_conexao: No connection right now. Try again.
erros.entre_primeiro: Sign in to your account first.
erros.invalido:codigo: This code doesn't look right: it has 12 letters and numbers.
erros.invalido:vazia: Add at least one #topic or one community.
erros.invalido:comunidade: Some community doesn't exist or isn't open. Only open communities are allowed.
erros.invalido:nome: Give it a name of 2 to 40 characters.
erros.muitas: You reached the limit of lines.
erros.linha:muitas: Your lines on this device are at the limit. Delete one in My lines.
erros.linha:repetida: You already have a line with this name on this device.
erros.invalido:link: Use the official link, starting with https://.
erros.invalido:prazo: The deadline must be from today on (up to 2 years).
erros.invalido:titulo: Write a title of 5 to 160 characters.
erros.invalido:orgao: Say who offers it (2 to 80 characters).
erros.fila_cheia: The review queue is full. Try tomorrow.
erros.invalido:nota: Scores go from 0 to 200, in steps of 40.
erros.invalido:comentario: Each competence needs a comment of 20 to 800 characters.
erros.invalido:geral: The general comment can have up to 800 characters.
erros.invalido:questoes: Pick 3 to 20 questions from the bank.
erros.invalido:respostas: Answer with one option per question (or leave it blank).
erros.ja_aberto: This class already has an open mock exam. Close it before opening another.
erros.encerrado: This mock exam has already ended.
erros.cedo: To be a mentor, the account needs 90 days.
erros.ja_tem: You already have mentoring in this track.
erros.invalido:vagas: From 1 to 3 people at a time.

assuntos.ajuda: Only #topics, never people or posts. Tap a topic to see its posts.
assuntos.vazio: No #topic is circulating in 3 communities at the same time right now.
assuntos.regra: A #topic enters when it was used in the last {horas} hours in posts from at least {comunidades} different communities, by at least {pessoas} different people. We only count posts any Alumia member can already see: no closed community, held post or suspended account, and no topic moderation removed. We show up to {maximo} topics, from the one in most communities to the one in fewest. We do not count likes, clicks or who you follow: the list is the same for everyone.

emDia.texto: From here down is what you already saw last time. You can close Alumia without missing anything.

escolha.ajuda: When on, the main tabs of the feed (in arrival order) stop at the first post you had already seen and show "You're all caught up". To keep going, tap "See older posts".
escolha.rotulo: Stop the feed when I'm caught up
escolha.aparelho: This choice and where you stopped stay only on this device. When off, the feed keeps loading by itself, as always.
escolha.ligado: Done: the feed will stop when you're caught up.
escolha.desligado: Done: the feed loads by itself again.

ritmo.ajuda: Log the time you studied. It counts by week: missing a day breaks nothing.
ritmo.metaFeita: Weekly goal done. Resting counts too.
ritmo.semPunir: No streak, no scoreboard and no "behind": each week starts from zero.
ritmo.aparelho: All of this stays only on this device, for 8 weeks. Nobody else sees it, not even Alumia.
ritmo.esquecerConfirmar: Erase all the pace saved on this device? This cannot be undone.

fediverso.ajuda: Follow a public Fediverse #topic, only from the servers the coordination approved. Only the text arrives; photos and avatars stay out.
fediverso.nenhum: You don't follow any outside #topic yet.
fediverso.semNotas: Nothing recent in this #topic on the approved servers.
fediverso.temaTorto: Use only unaccented letters, numbers and "_" (2 to 40).
fediverso.muitos: You can follow up to {n} outside #topics.
fediverso.aparelho: The #topics you follow stay only on this device. Alumia's server fetches from the outside servers without saying who asked: your device never talks to them.
fediverso.servidoresAjuda: The coordination chooses which servers Alumia reads #topics from. A blocked server never gets in.
fediverso.dominioTorto: Write only the domain, like exemplo.social.

feeds.ajuda: Follow an open community or a #topic in any RSS or Atom reader, without an account.
feeds.qualComunidade: The community address (the name that comes after /c/)
feeds.slugTorto: Use only lowercase unaccented letters, numbers and hyphens.
feeds.copieAMao: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it.
feeds.regra: Only posts open to the internet, from open communities, by people who let their posts leave Alumia: the same as the RSS that already existed. No closed community, local group, followers-only post or locked account. Up to 30 posts from the last 120 days, text only.
feeds.semConta: People reading by RSS or Atom need no account, and Alumia keeps nothing about readers.

linhas.ajuda: A line is a rule: posts with certain #topics or from certain open communities. Publish yours for others to follow, or follow someone's by code.
linhas.sigo: Lines I follow on this device
linhas.nenhumaSeguida: You don't follow any line yet.
linhas.nenhumaPublicada: You haven't published any line yet.
linhas.copieAMao: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it.
linhas.tirarConfirmar: Remove this line? Its followers stop getting it.
linhas.privacidade: Alumia doesn't keep who follows a line or how many people follow it, and the line doesn't show who made it. Posts go through the same rule of who can see them.
linhas.seguindo: Done: "{nome}" is in your lines on this device.
linhas.comunidades: Open communities (up to 5, by the address name)
linhas.soAbertas: Only #topics and open communities: nothing that depends on who reads.

baralhos.ajuda: Question-and-answer cards that come back at the right time: what you miss comes back today, what is easy takes longer.
baralhos.emDia: Nothing to review today. Come back tomorrow, or add cards.
baralhos.vazio: You have no cards on this device yet. Create the first one alongside.
baralhos.mesmoDoSite: It's the same deck as the site's studies: what you saved there shows up here.
baralhos.guardado: Card saved. It shows up today for its first review.
baralhos.naoEntrou: This card is already in the deck.
baralhos.aparelho: Cards and progress stay only on this device. Quick exit erases them.

fontes.ajuda: Keep the books, articles and pages you use and copy the ABNT reference and the in-text citation ready.
fontes.vazia: Your shelf is empty. Save the first source alongside.
fontes.copiarTudo: Copy the {n} references in alphabetical order
fontes.copieAMao: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it.
fontes.tirarConfirmar: Remove this source from the shelf?
fontes.autores: Authors (one name per line, or the institution)
fontes.muitas: The shelf reached 200 sources. Remove one to save another.
fontes.norma: Follows NBR 6023:2018 and NBR 10520 for common cases. Laws, films and interviews have their own rules: check with your advisor.
fontes.aparelho: The shelf stays only on this device. Quick exit erases it.

microlicoes.ajuda: One screen at a time, linked to the lessons of the site's Digital self-defense track. Answer the question to mark it done.
microlicoes.aparelho: What you've done stays only on this device. The micro-lessons are in Portuguese, like the track's lessons.

inscricoes.ajuda: ENEM, SISU, ProUni, FIES and Encceja in one place. Tap "Remind me" to get a notice 7 days and 1 day before.
inscricoes.semData: No date checked against the official source yet. Check the official page.
inscricoes.comLembrete: Done: you get a notice 7 days and 1 day before.
inscricoes.regra: Only dates with the official source and the day they were checked get in. If a date changes, whoever asked for a reminder is told.
inscricoes.cuida: To add or fix a date, use the exam calendar:

editais.ajuda: Open scholarships, calls, prizes, courses and internships, with the official link. The coordination checks each one before publishing.
editais.vazio: Nothing open right now. Saw one? Propose it alongside.
editais.confira: Open the official link and check the deadline before publishing.
editais.proposto: Received. After review, it shows up on the board.
editais.privacidade: The board doesn't say who proposed. After the deadline, the call leaves the board and is deleted 30 days later.

redacao.ajuda: For each week's topic in the essay circle, an educator shows what each of the 5 ENEM competences asks for.
redacao.semTema: The essay circle has no topic yet.
redacao.semReferencia: This week has no reference grading yet.
redacao.depoisDeCorrigir: The reference shows up after you grade an essay from this week in the circle, or when the circle closes. That way you read with your own eyes first.
competencias: understanding the prompt and developing the topic
redacao.privacidade: The reference doesn't say who wrote it. The circle stays anonymous:
redacao.escreverAjuda: Explain what each level asks for, with examples from the topic. People in the circle only see it after grading.
redacao.comentario: What this competence asks for in this topic

simulado.ajuda: Everyone answers in the same window. At the end, the class only sees how each question went ("most got it right", "about half"), and only if 3 or more people answered.
simulado.semTurma: You're not in any study class yet.
simulado.nenhum: No mock exam in this class yet.
simulado.enviado: Answers sent. You can change them until the end.
simulado.voce: You got {n} of {total} right (only you see this, on this device).
simulado.semAsSuas: Your answers aren't on this device, so you can't check them here.
simulado.semResultado: Fewer than 3 people answered: the class result doesn't show.
simulado.encerrado: Mock exam closed. Answers were deleted; only the class result remains.
simulado.questoes: Questions from the bank ({n} chosen, 3 to 20)
simulado.aberto: Mock exam open for the class.
simulado.privacidade: Nobody sees who answered or what each person chose. Answers vanish at the end; yours stay only on your device.

mentoria.ajuda: Someone who has walked a track accompanies someone starting out. The pair is drawn at random and arranges everything by message.
mentoria.semPar: You don't have a mentoring pair yet.
mentoria.encerrarConfirmar: End this mentoring? The pair disappears for both.
mentoria.privacidade: Nobody sees the list of mentors or how many there are. Only the two people in the pair see each other.
mentoria.ha: There is mentoring in this track.
mentoria.naoHa: Right now there is no mentoring with a free spot in this track. Try another day.
mentoria.feito: Done: {codinome} will accompany you. Send a message to arrange.
mentoria.cedo: Mentoring requires an account 90 days old or more. You'll get there soon.
mentoria.vagas: How many people at a time
mentoria.oferecido: Offer saved. When someone asks, the pair shows up here.

glossario.ajuda: The entries of the site's glossary. In study texts, tap an underlined word to see what it means.
glossario.semLista: The glossary didn't load right now. Try again later.
glossario.colar: Paste a text to mark the glossary terms
glossario.aparelho: The pasted text stays only on this screen: it goes nowhere and disappears when you leave.
